caveat: All three checks are IN-SAMPLE over the same 7 months used to build the original b1_wait_window.json curve (Task 16). Surviving these checks means the curve's shape is not an artifact of a few large trades or of a single lucky month within this substrate -- it does NOT mean the curve, or any rung on it, will hold out of sample. This module does not recommend a rung to deploy; the B1 mask verdict is pre-committed at 50 minutes in b6_masks.py and does not move because of anything here.
